# watchpoint_sso_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps an SSO group claim to a local user group within an SSO configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_sso_group_mapping" "example" {
  config_id       = "sso_001"
  sso_group_claim = "Engineering"
  group_id        = "grp_001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_id` (String) ID of the SSO configuration this mapping belongs to.
- `sso_group_claim` (String) The SSO group claim value to match (e.g. an IdP group name or ID).

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) ID of the local user group to assign. May be omitted to leave it unmapped.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group mapping ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_sso_group_mapping.example sso_001/map_001
```
